gitvc01.title: 01 / Begin without a development line
gitvc01.caption: The fictional repository exists on GitHub, but no linked development Project is open. todo only inspects the current state.
lines: No open dev line project (vX.Y.x) found for example-lab/atlas-tools.

gitvc-first.title: 02 / Create the first task
gitvc-first.caption: rel init creates and links the initial v0.0.x Project, then adds the first feature issue. “Open dev line found” is the command’s message even when it just created that line.
lines: rel init "Create the command-line entry point"

Open dev line found: v0.0.x (#19)
Creating items (kind=feature):
  • created: #1 Create the command-line entry point

Open dev line (Project): v0.0.x (#19)
   Patch: rel p #<issue>   | Minor: rel m   | Major: rel M

- [TODO] #1  Create the command-line entry point

gitvc02.title: 03 / Grow the backlog
gitvc02.caption: One repository, one development line: add a fix and another feature. Issue numbers #1, #2 and #3 remain consistent throughout this guide.
lines:
Open dev line found: v0.0.x (#19)
Creating items (kind=fix):
  • created: #2 (FIX) Handle missing export folders
rel init "Add a project summary command"

Open dev line found: v0.0.x (#19)
Creating items (kind=feature):
  • created: #3 Add a project summary command

gitvc03.title: 04 / Review the pending work
gitvc03.caption: todo lists the Project items. rel todo <issue> changes a status; it is not the listing command.
lines:
Open dev line (Project): v0.0.x (#19)
   Patch: rel p #<issue>   | Minor: rel m   | Major: rel M

- [TODO] #1  Create the command-line entry point
- [TODO] #3  Add a project summary command
- [FIX]  #2  Handle missing export folders

gitvc04.title: 05 / Deliver the first task
gitvc04.caption: After committing and pushing the implementation, rel p 1 creates a patch tag and marks #1 Done. The other two issues stay pending.
lines:
[info] example-lab/atlas-tools
[info] Tag to create: v0.0 -> v0.0.1
[info] Tag created: v0.0.1 (at main)
[info] project item #1 marked as Done.

Open dev line (Project): v0.0.x (#19)
   Patch: rel p #<issue>   | Minor: rel m   | Major: rel M

- [done] #1  Create the command-line entry point
- [TODO] #3  Add a project summary command
- [FIX]  #2  Handle missing export folders

gitvc05.title: 06 / Publish the minor release
gitvc05.caption: Condensed successful-path illustration. After publishing v0.1, verify that both unfinished issues are present in the next development line.
lines:
[info] example-lab/atlas-tools
[info] Tag to create: v0.0.1 -> v0.1
[info] Release created: v0.1
…
Project closed: v0.1 (released) (#19)

Open dev line (Project): v0.1.x (#20)
   Patch: rel p #<issue>   | Minor: rel m   | Major: rel M

- [TODO] #3  Add a project summary command
- [FIX]  #2  Handle missing export folders

gitvc06.title: 07 / Prepare a major version
gitvc06.caption: Once #2 and #3 have actually been implemented and pushed, mark them Done and publish the major version. State cards summarize the result; they are not execution output.
states: v1.0.x · created if you confirm the prompt

gitvc-help.title: Reference / The supported commands
gitvc-help.caption: rel task is unsupported. The help output names rel init as the command for new feature tasks.
lines:
Usage:
  rel init Item A -- Item B -- Item C
  rel fix Item A -- Item B -- Item C
  rel p <issue>        (patch release)
  rel m                (minor release)
  rel M                (major release)
  rel todo <issue>     (set Status=Todo)
  rel progress <issue> (set Status=In Progress)
  rel done <issue>     (set Status=Done)
